Tired of dating apps, surface-level conversations, and events that don’t reflect where you are in life?
This South Asian Singles Mixer is designed specifically for marriage-minded professionals who value intention, emotional maturity, and meaningful connection.
There are no timers, no rotations, and no forced pairings. Instead, we create a thoughtfully structured social experience that allows conversations to flow naturally — in a relaxed, respectful, and well-hosted environment.

Who This Event Is ForTo maintain the quality and intention of the experience, please do not purchase a ticket unless you meet at least four (4) of the following criteria:
You are genuinely interested in a long-term, marriage-oriented relationshipYou have completed a university or college degree/diplomaYou are fluent in English and enjoy thoughtful conversationYou have 2+ years of professional experience in your fieldYou are passionate about your career and personal growthYou have an ambitious, forward-thinking mindsetYou have founded or co-founded a business at least 1 year agoYou are a high-earning professionalYou are socially confident and have had meaningful relationships in the past
(If unsure, we recommend emailing us or booking a short consultation before purchasing.)
